# Tallinn trip guide: 2027-05-15 – 2027-05-15

Two adults travelling from Helsinki to Tallinn for a low‑budget day‑trip focused on history and food. The guide uses typical weather for mid‑May (overcast, 9‑18 °C) rather than a forecast.

## Getting there and back
**Chosen outbound** – Viking Line ferry, depart 10:13 → arrive 13:23, duration 3 h 10 min, 2 stops, price **€30 (web estimate)**, [details & booking](https://www.vikingline.com/find-your-trip/trips-for-individuals/)

**Chosen return** – Tallink Grupp AS ferry, depart 19:11 → arrive 21:54, duration 2 h 43 min, 3 stops, price **€77.8 (web estimate)**, [details & booking](https://en.tallink.com/book-a-cruise?voyageType=SHUTTLE)

**Note** – Ferry journeys require tram/bus transfers in both cities; allow extra time for these connections. Flight prices are for both travellers and include only personal items.

## Where to stay
No overnight stay is needed – this is a same‑day trip returning the same evening.

## Day by day
*Days in this plan start around 09:30 and end by 22:00, at a balanced pace (the defaults). For another rhythm, tell the concierge, e.g. "we wake up early, start at 07:00", "we stay out late" or "a more relaxed pace, please".*

### Day 1 – Sat 2027-05-15: Old Town
*Weather:* overcast, 9‑18 °C *Walking:* ~0.7 km

- **13:23 Arrive in Tallinn** – Viking Line ferry arrival. (see Getting there)
- **14:15 Toompea Castle** – Medieval castle on Toompea hill, now housing the Estonian Parliament. It shows layers of Danish, German and Russian influence. Open 10:00–16:00. Ticket: *ticket price: see the website*.
  [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Tallinn)
- **15:45 St. Nicholas Church** – 16th‑century church home to the Museum of St. Nicholas and the famous Danse Macabre altarpiece. Open 10:00–17:00. Ticket **€3.5**.
  [source](https://nigulistemuuseum.ekm.ee/en/st-nicholas-church/)
- **17:00 Dinner at Loca** – Low‑price fast‑food joint serving pizza, falafel and hummus. Budget‑tier: low. Open 11:00–07:00.
  [source](http://www.loca.ee)
- **19:11 Depart from Tallinn** – Tallink Grupp AS ferry back to Helsinki.

## Food to try
- **Verivorst** – Pig's blood sausage, traditionally served with lingonberry jam and mulgikapsad. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Estonia#Eat)
- **Mustamakkara** – Finnish black‑pudding‑like blood sausage, a common winter dish similar to verivorst. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Estonia#Eat)
- **Mulgikapsad** – Sauerkraut stew often served alongside blood sausage. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Estonia#Eat)
- **Hapukoor** – Sour 20 %‑fat milk dressing used in salads, the Estonian equivalent of Russian smetana. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Estonia#Eat)
- **Kartulisalat** – Traditional Estonian potato salad, usually dressed with sour cream. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Estonia#Eat)
- **Kohuke** – Flavoured milk‑curd sweet covered in chocolate, a popular snack sold in supermarkets. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Estonia#Eat)
